panel.no_reply: No reply from the bot: press the button again
choice.no_such_button: That button does not match any option.
pile.where.shuffle: into your deck and shuffle it
pile.where.bottom: at the bottom of your deck
pile.instruction: {card}: take {how} out of your discard pile{kind}, put it {where} and press Done. I detect which one you moved.
pile.instruction_many: {card}: take {how} out of your discard pile{kind}, put them {where} and press Done. I detect which ones you moved.
pile.status: Move the card from your discard pile to your deck and press Done
pile.unreadable: I could not read your discard pile: press Done again.
pile.wrong: {titles} cannot be chosen with {card}: put it back in your discard pile and press Done.
pile.too_many: You took {n} cards out of the discard pile ({titles}) and you may take only {max}. Put the extra ones back and press Done.
pile.none: I do not see that you took any card out of your discard pile: take it, put it in your deck and press Done.
pile.too_few: I only see {n} card(s) out of the discard pile and you have to move {min}.
moves.where.adjacent: on a free space next to {who}
moves.where.nearest: on the free space nearest to {who}
moves.optional: (or press Don't move if you prefer to leave it where it is)
moves.put: {head}Put {name} on the board {where} and press Done.
moves.status.move: Move {name} on the table and press Done
moves.status.place: Place {name} on the table and press Done
moves.occupied: That space is occupied by {holder} ({spot}): move {name} to a free one.
moves.must_end: {name} has to end up {where}; it is now at {spot}.
moves.too_short: {name} moved {squares}; it has to move exactly {steps}.
moves.no_path: From where it was, {name} cannot reach that space in {squares} without passing through enemy fighters (this card does not allow it): find another path or another space.
moves.also_moved: {other} was also moved: put it back in its place ({spot}) and press Done.
moves.not_found: I cannot find the miniature of {name} on the table.
moves.off_board: {name} is off the board ({dist} from the nearest space): put it on a space and press Done.
hidden.start: You lost the combat with a card that lets you look at the bot's hand and choose {cards} for it to discard. Take it out of the green hand zone (Green) yourself to see it; put the chosen card face up on the bot's discard pile, put the rest back in its hand and press Done.
hidden.status: Discard 1 bot card by hand, put the rest back and press Done
hidden.foreign: That card is not from the bot's hand: its discard pile holds a card that is not its own ({titles}). Remove it and press Done.
hidden.extra_in_hand: The bot's hand holds cards that do not belong to it: {titles}. Remove them and press Done.
hidden.too_many: You discarded {n} cards; you may discard only 1 ({titles}). Put the extra ones back and press Done.
hidden.missing: Cards are missing from the bot's hand: put {titles} back in its hand (Green zone) and press Done.
hidden.nothing_yet: You have not discarded any card yet: put the chosen one face up on the bot's discard pile and press Done.
hidden.unseen: {titles} is on the discard pile but was not in the bot's hand: remove it and press Done.
hidden.discards: The bot discards {card} (the one you chose).
hidden.keeps_wildfire: The bot keeps {card} (Wildfire returns it to its hand).
hidden.empty_hand: You look at the bot's hand: it has no cards in hand.
hidden.not_visible: You look at the bot's hand, but I cannot see its cards on the table: ask it to show them.
hidden.row_pick: The bot puts its hand face up ({n} cards) and pings: choose one with a ping (Tab) on the card or with its panel button.
hidden.row_reveal: The bot puts its hand face up ({n} cards) and pings: you only look. Press End action or Cancel and it picks it up.
hidden.row_failed.pick: I could not put the bot's hand on the table: its cards are in the chat, choose with the panel buttons.
hidden.row_failed.reveal: I could not put the bot's hand on the table: its cards are in the chat.
hidden.row_failed.grant: I could not take the cards out of the bot's hand; repeat Look at bot's hand.
hidden.look_status.pick: Bot's hand in view: Tab on the card you choose, or its button
hidden.look_status.reveal: Bot's hand in view: End action or Cancel puts it away
hidden.look_status.grant: Bot's hand in view: Tab on the card to discard, or Cancel
hidden.resume.pick: The bot's hand is still in view: choose a card with a ping (Tab) or with its panel button.
hidden.resume.reveal: The bot's hand is still in view (look only): press End action or Cancel and it picks it up.
hidden.resume.grant: The bot's hand is still in view: ping (Tab) the card to discard or press Cancel.
hidden.ping_reveal: This time you only look: press End action or Cancel and the bot picks up its hand.
hidden.ping_not_now: That card cannot be chosen now.
hidden.close.discard_row: The bot discards {card} and puts the rest back in its hand.
hidden.close.discard_hand: The bot discards {card} (it was still in its hand) and picks up its hand.
hidden.close.deck_row: {card} goes on top of the bot's deck; the rest goes back to its hand.
hidden.close.deck_hand: {card} goes on top of the bot's deck: it was still in its hand, put it on top of its deck yourself; the bot picks up its hand.
hidden.close.wildfire_kept: The bot keeps {card} (Wildfire returns it) and picks up its hand.
hidden.close.kept_hits: The bot keeps {card} and {hits} and picks up its hand.
hidden.close.discard_bounce: The bot discards {card} (Wildfire returns it to its hand) and picks up its hand.
hidden.close.kept: The bot keeps {card} and picks up its hand.
hidden.close.collect: The bot picks up its hand.
hidden.fail.not_in_row: that card was not in the row on the table
hidden.fail.not_in_discard: {card} is not yet visible on the bot's discard pile
hidden.fail.where_discard: and put {card} on its discard pile
hidden.fail.where_deck: and put {card} on top of its deck
hidden.fail.row: The table did not close the bot's row ({fail}): put its cards back in its hand{where}; press End action to sync.
hidden.ask_prediction: {card}: predict the printed value of the bot's card (you play it face up) or play it face down, with the panel buttons. The bot chooses its defense afterwards.
hidden.face_down: You play the card face down: no prediction.
hidden.predicted: You predict the bot's card has printed value {value}: your card is played face up.
hidden.intuition_notice: UNCANNY INTUITION: {name} has an active token: it spends it, draws 1 card and your attack is played face up. Put your card face down as usual and press Reveal: I turn it and the bot chooses its defense seeing it.
hidden.intuition_face_up: UNCANNY INTUITION: your attack is played face up: {card} (value {value}); the bot chooses its defense seeing it.
hidden.bot_predicts: The bot plays {card} face up and predicts that the printed value of your card is {n}.
hidden.bot_intuition: UNCANNY INTUITION: {name} has an active token: you spend one, draw 1 card (I deal it to you) and the bot's attack is played face up: {card} (value {value}).
fx.no_spot: There is no human_ongoing_spot in the configuration: I recognize your ONGOING in your discard pile. Configure the ONGOING zones and calibrate them with --read-only.
fx.not_ongoing: {title} is not an ONGOING: I do not count it in your ONGOING zone. Move it to your discard pile and press End action.
fx.detected: I detect {title}: the card asks you for a choice.
fx.no_actions: {title}: you do not gain its actions (an effect in play prevents it), you have {left} left.
fx.replaces: and replaces {title} (only one ONGOING per player)
fx.where_discard: in plain sight in your discard pile
fx.in_play: {title} stays in play{replaced}: leave it {where}, I keep it in mind until it expires.
fx.mandatory: This choice is mandatory (the card is already played): choose one of the panel options.
fx.cancelled: Choice cancelled: it resolves without doing anything.
fx.ability.detective_draw: OCCULT DETECTIVE: you are on the rival's start space: you may draw 2 cards (or none); choose on the panel and I deal them to you.
fx.ability.anung_discard_move: ANUNG UN RAMA: discard 1 card (mandatory) and move {hero} up to the BOOST of that card.
fx.ability.wildfire_start: WILDFIRE: discard the bottom card of your deck. If it is burning, 1 damage to another fighter in {hero}'s zone (use -1 on it; the burning card returns to your hand); if not, move {hero} up to 2 spaces.
choice.no_draw_reason: an effect in play prevents you from drawing cards, so you do not draw
choice.prompt.optional: Do you want to do it?
choice.prompt.predict: Predict the printed value of the rival card, or play face down
choice.prompt.redirect: Does {to} take the damage ({amount}) instead of {fighter}?
choice.prompt.use_effect: Do you use the effect of {title}?
choice.pick_between: Choose between {min} and {max} options and confirm.
choice.pick_max: You may choose only {max}: remove one first.
choice.restrict.attack: An effect in play prevents you from attacking now (for example, an attack as the first action of the turn): the attack buttons are hidden.
choice.restrict.draw: An effect in play prevents you from drawing cards (Cold Iron And Holy Water): the Maneuver only moves, {why}.
choice.restrict.gain_actions: An effect in play prevents you from gaining actions: schemes that give actions do not give them to you this turn.
choice.restrict.move: An effect in play prevents one of your miniatures from leaving its space: if you move it, I put it back.
ops.random_positions: {title}, at random: {which} of your hand counting from the left
narr.looks.human: you look at the bot's hand
narr.price.cannot_pay: the bot cannot pay (it lacks the cards to discard {cards}): it takes {stake} damage
narr.price.prefers: it prefers to take {stake} damage rather than lose {cards} cards
narr.price.no_change: it does not change the combat
narr.price.ignores: the bot {paid} to ignore the value of {title} (it becomes 0; {why})
narr.fighter.back: {fid} returns to the board at {spot} with {hp} HP
narr.from_deck.one: {n} card from the deck to {su} hand
narr.from_deck.other: {n} cards from the deck to {su} hand
narr.hand_to_deck: from the hand to the deck
narr.fstatus.cannot_leave_space: {fid} cannot leave its space this turn
narr.fstatus.immune_to_effect_damage: {fid} takes no effect damage this turn
narr.status.cannot_gain_actions.bot: does not gain actions this turn
narr.status.cannot_gain_actions.human: you do not gain actions this turn
narr.status.cannot_draw.bot: does not draw cards this turn
narr.status.cannot_draw.human: you do not draw cards this turn
narr.status.immune_to_effect_damage.bot: its fighters take no effect damage this turn
narr.status.immune_to_effect_damage.huma: your fighters take no effect damage this turn
tbl.where.nearest_hero: as close as possible to your hero
tbl.put: put {fid} on the board ({where}) with {hp} HP
tbl.deck.bottom: at the bottom of your deck
tbl.look.first: the first {n} cards of your deck
tbl.rest.bottom_random: the rest at the bottom in random order
tbl.rest.bottom_ordered: the rest at the bottom in the order you like
tbl.rest.top_ordered: the rest on top in the order you like
tbl.search: look at {look}, put {take} in your hand and {rest}
play.reload_missing: TTS reloaded the game and objects from the configuration are missing: {missing}. I stop without touching the table; load the right game and resume with --resume.
play.reload_retry: TTS reloaded the game and does not answer yet ({error}); retrying.
play.reload_ok: TTS reloaded the game: GUIDs checked and panel recreated. Press End action so the bot rereads the table.
play.internal_error: Internal bot error; the game goes on. Repeat the button or use Cancel attack.
